title: Solar DC Protection Price in Pakistan 2026 — DC MCB, String Fuse Holder, DC Surge Arrester & DC Circuit Breaker PV Array Buyer Guide
summary_html: Complete buyer guide to solar DC protection in Pakistan 2026: DC MCBs (500V–1000V), string fuse holders (gPV IEC 60269-6), DC surge protective devices (SPD Type II, IEC 61643-11), DC load break isolators and PV combiner boxes. PKR prices, system-size selection tables (3 kW–100 kW), IEC 60898-1/60947-2/60947-3 compliance checklist, NEPRA SRO 892 net metering requirements and PEPCO/DISCO DC disconnect rules. Includes the 5 most common DC protection mistakes on Pakistani rooftops and how to fix them.
